cold_verifier_artifacts.scope: Inventory-based cold-verifier artifact accounting for the actual three-rank seed, input checkpoint and transcript. Excludes prepared data, source/runtime, tokenizer assets, small transcript/teacher manifests and output commitment metadata. Output tensors are regenerated by replay. Streaming limits resident GPU memory, not total downloads.

evidence_archive.scope: Operator-stored evidence with frozen inputs/numerical sources, current native sources, all declared evaluations, public native trial summaries and complete checkpoint receipts. Private keys and Git history are excluded. Weights and Adam states are separate S3 objects.

fresh_post_claim.scope: Actual post-claim GPU replay through persistent native audit daemons, one operator, isolated chain; no public balance or serving changes

hardened_cached.scope: Isolated native genesis and actual cached GPU replay; no public-chain balances or serving promotion changed

initial_cached.scope: Isolated native genesis and actual cached GPU replay; no public-chain balances or serving promotion changed

growth.scope: Frozen generated task families and public conversation retention; not general assistant quality

resources.scope: Planning estimate, not AWS invoice. Compute counts each GPU through confirmed termination. Training-host interface counters and retired-auditor CloudWatch sums include backups and intra-AZ traffic, all charged conservatively at $0.02/GB in this planning estimate. Retained S3 storage accrues separately.

scope: One operator, matching A10G GPUs and public generated task families. Correct replay, model quality, growth usefulness and decentralization are distinct claims. Native rewards belong to separate isolated chains; public balances and serving were unchanged.
